snippet.title: MOXIE // Graffiti Burst - Official Release Trailer (OUT NOW)
snippet.description:
Buy here (3.99): https://platinaxo.itch.io/moxie-graffiti-burst
Support me: https://ko-fi.com/peanutellaxo

MOXIE // Graffiti Burst, a skate-n-tag game for the Game Boy Color is out NOW! 
Help Veve win an upcoming skating tournament in the city of the Mischievous South, assembling a group of misfits along the way as they form their crew, MOXIE. Unfortunately for her, President Peckington, and the Hound Killer are after you to end your reign of tagging terror! Can you help Veve outmanoeuvre them and take the crown?
20 levels, achievements with art rewards, high-speed and replayability await you in this game oozing with so much steez, you don't even want to stop playing!. 


Made with GBStudio.
Music in trailer: PlatinaXO - Food Fight! (Demo)
